workload_lunch_minutes_007.evidence: At pilot schools all staff will have a flexible seven and one-half (7.5)-hour professional day plus a duty-free, thirty (30)-minute lunchtime.

workload_meetings_limits_008.evidence: One day a week for Collaboration with a minimum of thirty (30) Collaborative Time meetings for the year. One day a week for School Leadership or Professional Learning Time. One day a week for Committee Time.
